## Danny Trottance — G4 colt

**Who is he?** A briefly seen Earth-pony colt at the Grand Galloping Gala in *Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (season 5, episode 7, around 14:33). His sweater and alarmed expressions are an Easter-egg homage to **Danny Torrance**, the child from *The Shining*—not a secret identity or literally that character. [Foal listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals)

**Appearance:** Pale seafoam-green coat, muted olive-gray mane and tail, amber/golden-brown eyes, and a sweater. Recognize him by the frightened reaction shots amid the Gala chaos.

**Name/history:** “Danny Trottance” is the fandom/wiki identification, a pony pun on “Danny Torrance.” The foal listing says MLP storyboard artist Sabrina Alberghetti called him a “Danny pony”; that supports the intended reference, but I could not verify “Danny Trottance” as a spoken, credited, or merchandise name. The source's name and the pony are distinct characters in different continuities.

**Speaking and appearances:** No verified dialogue or credited voice actor. The documented G4 appearance is *Make New Friends but Keep Discord*; no further film or comic appearances were verified.
